scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Oh...!
You're {0} !
You've grown so much!
I'm truly proud of you.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
噢...！
是你啊，{0}！
你长大了好多！
我真的很为你感到骄傲。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
May you
always be blessed...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
愿祝福永远与你同在...

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Welcome, little one.
Fate must have brought
us together so that we'd
meet today. It's nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
欢迎，小家伙。
命运让我们在今天相遇，真是很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
You're looking for someone
that handles things with Archers
at the church? Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
你在找负责处理弓箭手事务的人吗？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Oh my, you seem
to be growing quickly
into your role as an Acolyte.
Was the training difficult?
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
天哪，你作为服事的成长速度真快。
训练辛苦吗？

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
You are such a good person,
a true child of the light. I hope that many others will benefit from the purity of your heart and mind.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
你真是个善良的人，是真正的光之子。我希望更多人能从你纯净的心灵中受益。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
You must now find
your own path and become
a better Acolyte using
your own strength.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
现在，你必须找到自己的道路，凭借自己的力量成为一名更优秀的服事。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Sister Asthe in the Saint Capitolina Convent is such
a sincere and loving person.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
圣卡波利纳修女院的阿斯忒修女是个非常真诚且充满爱心的人。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
But I am concerned that
you may not know what to do
as an Acolyte from here on...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
但我担心你可能不知道接下来该如何作为服事行事...

scripts.text: I'm not worried.
scripts.translation: 我不担心

scripts.text: What should I do?
scripts.translation: 我该做什么？

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Seeing your eyes filled with such determination assures me. But if you run into any trouble, feel free to ask me for help. Good bye for now, blessed child.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
看到你眼中充满斗志，让我很安心。
但如果你遇到麻烦，随时可以向我求助。
再见了，受祝福的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
There is a convent northeast
of Prontera called the Saint Capitolina Convent. Go there and look for ^3131FF Sister Asthe^000000. She is a sweet and gentle soul who has
much to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
在普隆德拉的东北方，有一座叫圣卡波利纳修女院的地方。去那里找^3131FF阿斯忒修女^000000吧。
她是个温柔善良的灵魂，有很多东西可以教你。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
I look forward to seeing you
become a better Acolyte after learning from Sister Asthe's instructions. If you like, I can send you to the convent.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
我很期待看到你在阿斯忒修女的指导下成为一名更优秀的服事。
如果你愿意，我可以送你到修女院。

scripts.text: Go to the convent.
scripts.translation: 去修女院

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Please say hello
to Sister Asthe for me.
Have a safe trip, little one...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
请替我问候阿斯忒修女。
一路顺风，小家伙...

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
If you'd like,
I can send you to
the convent at anytime.
Whenever you feel like
you need help, come to me.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
如果你愿意，我随时都可以送你到修女院。
当你觉得需要帮助时，就来找我吧。

scripts.text:
You're looking for someone
that handles things with Archers
at the church? Hmm...
scripts.translation:
你在找负责处理弓箭手事务的人吗？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Ah, he's away at the convent right now. If you want to meet Bishop Maugins in the Saint Capitolina Convent, travel ^3131FFnorth^000000, ^3131FFeast^000000, ^3131FFeast^000000 and then ^3131FFeast^000000 from Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
啊，他现在在修女院。如果你想见圣卡波利纳修女院的主教 莫金斯，从普隆德拉出发，向^3131FF北^000000、^3131FF东^000000、^3131FF东^000000，然后再向^3131FF东^000000走。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
You have something
to give me? Oh yes, the
receipt! I was wondering
what had happened. Thank
you for all of your trouble.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
你有东西要给我吗？
噢，是收据！我还在想它去哪了。
谢谢你的费心。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Oh my, oh my.
It's been a while.
I wonder if there is
anything I can give you?
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
哎呀，哎呀。
好久不见。
不知道我有什么可以送给你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
How about one of these?
I know I'm not offering much,
but they were quite helpful to me when I was a young Acolyte like yourself.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
这个怎么样？
我知道这不算什么贵重礼物，但在我像你一样还是年轻服事的时候，它们对我帮助很大。

scripts.text: Wand
scripts.translation: 法杖

scripts.text: Flail
scripts.translation: 连枷

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
I am worried, but I trust in your courage and affection. May you always be protected and may
you always be blessed.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
我很担心，但我相信你的勇气和爱心。
愿神永远保佑你，愿神永远赐福于你。

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Would you like me to send you to the convent so that you can learn from this wonderful teacher?
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
你想让我送你去修女院，向这位优秀的老师学习吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
Please say hello
to Sister Asthe for me.
Have a safe trip, little one...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
请替我问候阿斯忒修女。
一路顺风，小家伙...

scripts.text:
[Priest Praupin]
If you'd like,
I can send you to
the convent at anytime.
Whenever you feel like
you need help, come to me.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 普劳频]
如果你愿意，我随时都可以送你到修女院。
当你觉得需要帮助时，就来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh my...
How did such
a young Acolyte
manage to reach
this remote place?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哎呀...
这么年轻的服事是怎么来到这个偏僻的地方的？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
This castle, Saint Capitolina Convent, is a beautiful and peaceful place that brings
calm to any heart.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
这座圣卡波利纳修女院是一个美丽而宁静的地方，能让任何人的心灵得到平静。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I would like to give you an assignment, but what do you
think? I believe learning the basics is your most important
task for now.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我想给你布置一个任务，不过你觉得呢？
我认为学习基础是你目前最重要的任务。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh my!
Welcome back~
I see that you've
completed the assignment
already. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哎呀！
欢迎回来~
看来你已经完成了任务。做得好！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh my!
Welcome back~
I see that you've
completed the assignment.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哎呀！
欢迎回来~
看来你已经完成了任务。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Are you having
a hard time training
to learn Level 3 Heal?
Please don't be discouraged.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
学习治愈术 等级3训练起来很困难吗？
请不要气馁。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I suppose I can tell you a little more about the Acolyte job. You already know that Novices must train and go to Prontera Church to become an Acolyte, your First Job Class.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我想我可以再多告诉你一些关于服事职业的事。
你已经知道，初心者必须经过训练，并前往普隆德拉教堂才能成为服事，也就是你的一转职业。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
{0},
I just received this letter, but it seems to have been a mistake.
It's actually addressed
to Priest Gardron.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
{0}，我刚收到这封信，但看起来是个误会。
这其实是寄给牧师 加德伦的。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Would you please
deliver this letter
to Priest Gardron for me?
You can find him in the
building nearby.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
请帮我把这封信交给牧师 加德伦好吗？
你可以在附近的建筑里找到他。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You went to {0} on behalf of the convent for Priest Gardron? That must have been tough...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你代表修女院去{0}找牧师 加德伦了吗？
那一定很辛苦...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
How to expel
an evil spirit?
Why, it's the same
way that you would
remove a curse...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
如何驱逐恶灵？
嗯，这和解除诅咒的方法是一样的...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You remember that
you can learn Divine
Protection after learning
Blessing, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你记得在学会天使之赐福之后，就可以学习天使之护，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now it's time
for your next lesson.
Let's talk about the
^3131FFIncrease AGI^000000 skill which is
part of the Heal skill tree.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
现在是时候学习下一课了。
我们来谈谈^3131FF加速术^000000技能，它是治愈术技能树的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Once you learn
Level 1 Increase AGI,
you can begin learning
^3131FFDecrease AGI^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
一旦你学会了加速术 等级1，就可以开始学习^3131FF缓速术^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You've been learning
really quickly. I'm glad
that we've gotten to this
point already.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你学得真快。
我很高兴我们能这么快就学到这一步了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh dear...!
All of these things were delivered to me by accident! And some of these packages were supposed to
be sent to the Prontera Sanctuary!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哎呀...！
这些东西都是误送到我这里的！其中一些包裹本来是应该送到普隆德拉圣堂的！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Okay, don't
forget the order
in which you need
to deliver the letters
and packages. That's
very important.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
好的，别忘了你需要投递信件和包裹的顺序。
这一点非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ah, you're finishing
making all of those deliveries? Thank you very much! How was it meeting Priest Praupin after such
a long time?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
啊，你已经完成了所有的投递工作吗？非常感谢！
时隔这么久，见到牧师 普劳频感觉如何？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The last skill
I will teach you
about is ^3131FFAqua Benedicta^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我要教你的最后一个技能是^3131FF天使之泪^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
If you get into an
argument with someone,
talk it over while sharing
a nice, warm meal.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
如果你和别人发生了争执，不妨一边享用一顿温暖的美食，一边好好谈谈。

scripts.text: I came for fun.
scripts.translation: 我是来玩的

scripts.text: Priest Praupin suggested I come here.
scripts.translation: 牧师 普劳频建议我来这里

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
This convent is always quiet and peaceful. Sitting on the benches and feeling the almighty presense all around you is such a relaxing, meditative experience.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
这座修女院总是安静祥和。
坐在长椅上，感受着无处不在的神圣气息，是一种令人放松的冥想体验。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Priest Praupin?
He's a very kind man
who's always thinking
about others. So he's
sent you to me for training?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
牧师 普劳频？
他是个非常善良的人，总是为他人着想。
所以是他派你来找我接受训练的吗？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Before we begin,
why don't you rest
for a little bit? You must be tired after traveling all the way here. When you're ready, just come
see me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
在开始之前，你不妨先休息一下？
长途跋涉到这里，你一定很累了。
准备好了就来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Well then...
Shall we begin
the lessons?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那么...
我们开始上课吗？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
{0},
have you thought about what kind of Acolyte you would like to become? It's very important that you plan for the future that you want.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
{0}，你想过自己想成为什么样的服事吗？
规划你期望的未来是非常重要的。

scripts.text: One that supports others.
scripts.translation: 支持他人的服事

scripts.text: One that punishes evil.
scripts.translation: 惩罚邪恶的服事

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ah, you have such
a generous heart!
Healing the pain of others and supporting your comrades in battle. You must have become an Acolyte in order to become a ^3131FFPriest^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
啊，你的心真善良！
治愈他人的痛苦，在战斗中支持你的同志。
你一定是为了成为^3131FF牧师^000000才成为服事的吧。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Priests have great supportive abilities and the power to battle evil. They use weapons to battle monsters like other fighters, but are ^3131FFforbidden from using blades^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
牧师拥有强大的辅助能力和对抗邪恶的力量。
他们像其他战士一样使用武器与魔物战斗，但^3131FF禁止使用刀刃^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
We call those who use their fists as tools of divine punishment Monks. They deliver our message
of love and peace in a more... colorful manner.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我们将那些以拳头作为神圣惩罚工具的人称为武僧。
他们以更为...生动的方式传达爱与和平的信息。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
But the path towards becoming
a Monk will require great patience and self-restraint. You'll often see Monks training their minds
and bodies throughout the land.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
但通往武僧的道路需要极大的耐心和自制力。
你经常会看到武僧在各地磨练身心。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Well, you still have a long way to go. The best thing to do would be to take your time planning and consider your future seriously.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
嗯，你还有很长的路要走。
最好的办法是慢慢规划，认真考虑你的未来。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now,
{0}...
What do you think
is the most necessary
skill for an Acolyte?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
现在，{0}...
你认为服事最需要的技能是什么？

scripts.text: Heal
scripts.translation: 治愈术

scripts.text: Aqua Benedicta
scripts.translation: 天使之泪

scripts.text: Teleport
scripts.translation: 瞬间移动

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ah, yes.
^3131FFHeal ^000000 is a basic, yet important skill for people like us. It can recover your own health as
well as that of others.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
啊，是的。
^3131FF治愈术^000000 对我们来说是一个基础但重要的技能。它不仅能恢复自己的生命值，也能恢复他人的生命值。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
^3131FFAqua Benedicta^000000 blesses
normal water and turns it into Holy Water. This is an important skill, but not considered one of the essentials that all Acolytes
should know.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
^3131FF天使之泪^000000 可以祝福普通的水，将其转化为圣水。这是一个重要的技能，但并不是所有服事都必须掌握的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
In my opinion,
^3131FFHeal^000000 is the most important
skill that an Acolyte can learn. It's a special ability that can save others and defeat the
monsters borne of darkness.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
在我看来，^3131FF治愈术^000000 是服事能学到的最重要的技能。这是一种特殊的能力，可以拯救他人，并击败由黑暗诞生的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
^3131FFTeleport^000000 allows you to instantly move to another place. It is a great skill, but it's difficult to consider it necessary for all Acolytes.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
^3131FF瞬间移动^000000 可以让你瞬间移动到另一个地方。这是一个很棒的技能，但很难说它是所有服事都必须掌握的。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
In my opinion,
^3131FFHeal^000000 is the most important skill that an Acolyte can learn. It's a special ability that can save others and defeat the
monsters borne of darkness.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
在我看来，^3131FF治愈术^000000 是服事能学到的最重要的技能。这是一种特殊的能力，可以拯救他人，并击败由黑暗诞生的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You can use the holy power
in the Heal skill to attack Undead monsters (^3131FFShift + Heal^000000). The light of truth protects the righteous and destroys the wicked.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你可以使用治愈术中的神圣力量来攻击不死系魔物（^3131FFShift + 治愈术^000000）。真理之光保护正义，摧毁邪恶。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Just gather the
strength within your
heart into your hands...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
只需将心中的力量聚集到手中...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
HEAL !!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
治愈术！！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Well then, learn
the Heal skill up to
^3131FFLevel 3 ^000000 and then
return to me.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那么，请将治愈术修炼到^3131FF等级3^000000，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Your strength is undeveloped,
so fight weaker monsters for now.
I will lend you a Mace from the church, so use it well and ^3131FFreturn it^000000 when you're done, alright?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你的力量还未开发，所以先打些较弱的魔物吧。
我会借给你一把教堂的钝器，请好好使用，用完记得^3131FF归还^000000，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
First ^0033FFstart fighting monsters around each town such as Prontera^000000. It'd be more convenient to fight the monsters here, but they might be too strong for you right now.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
首先，^0033FF去普隆德拉等城镇周围打打魔物^000000。在这里打魔物会更方便，但对你来说可能太强了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I'll change your Save Point so that you will respawn in the convent. Once you've learned Level 3 Heal, you can use a Butterfly Wing to return here.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我会改变你的重生点，这样你死后就会在修女院复活。一旦你学会了等级3的治愈术，就可以使用蝴蝶翅膀回到这里。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You can also speak to ^3131FFPriest Praupin at the Prontera Church^000000
and he will send you back here.
He takes special care in helping young Acolytes.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你也可以和^3131FF普隆德拉教堂的牧师 普劳频^000000对话，他会把你送回来。
他特别关心年轻的服事。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Well then,
I hope you
have a safe trip.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那么，祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh my!
You've already
learned how to
properly use the
Heal skill. Very good!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哎呀！
你已经学会如何正确使用治愈术了。很好！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I believe you're
ready for me to discuss
the next subject. Now,
let's see... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我相信你已经准备好讨论下一个课题了。那么，让我看看... 嗯...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now, I would like to have the Mace back, if you don't mind.
By any chance, do you carry ^FF0000any other Mace with an elemental Property^000000?
If so, please store the mace somewhere first.
I am afraid that my sight is too bad to distinguish the difference...Hoho.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那么，如果不介意的话，我想把钝器收回来。
顺便问一下，你身上是否携带了^FF0000其他带有属性的钝器^000000？
如果有，请先把它存放在某个地方。
恐怕我的视力太差，分不清区别...呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Would you like me to take the mace away from your inventory now?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
要我现在从你的物品栏中把钝器取走吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: Let me check again.
scripts.translation: 让我再检查一下

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Okay, no problem.
Please make sure that you do not carry any ^FF0000Mace with an elemental Property^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
好的，没问题。
请确保你没有携带任何^FF0000带有属性的钝器^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Thank you so much.
You have returned the Mace.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
非常感谢。
你已经归还了钝器。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
But you must have forgotten the Mace I've lent you. Would you bring it back so that I can return it to the church?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
不过，你似乎忘了还我之前借给你的钝器。能把它带回来吗？这样我才能把它归还给教会。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The basics are crucial to gaining mastery of the more advanced skills that you'll learn later. Just keep in mind that all of your efforts and suffering will become glory
and happiness.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
基础对于掌握你之后将学习的高级技能至关重要。请记住，你所有的努力和苦难终将化为荣耀与幸福。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
After you become an Acolyte
at ^3131FFJob Level 40^000000, you will have the opportunity to change to a more specialized Second Job Class.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
当你在^3131FF职业等级 40^000000时晋升为服事后，你将有机会转职为更专业的二转职业。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
When changing
to the Second Jobs,
Acolytes can become ^3131FFPriests^000000,
the apostles of mercy, or ^3131FFMonks^000000
who carry out God's wrath.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
在转职为二转职业时，服事可以成为^3131FF牧师^000000，即慈悲的使徒；或者成为^3131FF武僧^000000，执行上帝的愤怒。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Priests and Monks can
change to the Transcendent Class
by visiting Valkyrie in Valhalla. Priests can become ^3131FFHigh Priests^000000 and Monks can become ^3131FFChampions^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
牧师和武僧可以前往瓦尔哈拉找瓦尔基里转职为超转职业。牧师可以成为^3131FF神官^000000，武僧可以成为^3131FF武术宗师^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Did you undertand all that?
Ho ho ho~ No need to try to remember everything right now. You'll get the hang of it.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你都理解了吗？
呵呵呵~ 现在不需要试着记住所有东西。你会慢慢习惯的。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
However, I'm a little busy with
my work right now, so would you deliver this to Priest Gardron in the next building for me?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
不过，我现在工作有点忙，能麻烦你把这个送到隔壁建筑的牧师 加德伦那里吗？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Blessing!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
天使之赐福！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now I'm going to teach you
about ^FF0000Blessing^000000. This is a holy skill that delivers the blessing of God. Blessing will temporarily raise ^3131FFSTR^000000,^3131FFINT^000000,^3131FFDEX^000000 and remove ^3131FFCurse^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
现在我要教你^FF0000天使之赐福^000000。这是一种神圣技能，能传达上帝的祝福。天使之赐福会暂时提升^3131FFSTR^000000、^3131FFINT^000000、^3131FFDEX^000000，并解除^3131FF诅咒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Like Heal,
Blessing can be used
against Undead monsters.
(^3131FFSHIFT + Blessing^000000)
Blessing will actually
place a curse on the Undead.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
和治愈术一样，天使之赐福也可以对不死系魔物使用。（^3131FFSHIFT + 天使之赐福^000000）
实际上，天使之赐福会对不死系魔物施加诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Blessing can be learned after you learn Level 5 ^3131FFDivine Protection^000000. That's the skill that will increase your resistance to damage from Undead and Demon monsters.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
天使之赐福可以在你学会5级^3131FF天使之护^000000后习得。那是能增加你对不死系和恶魔系魔物伤害抵抗力的技能。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Being able to serve God and
bless others with his glory is a great honor. Well, that's all for this lesson.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
能够侍奉上帝，并用他的荣耀祝福他人，是一种莫大的荣幸。好了，这节课就到这里。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh, yes...!
In the cemetary northwest
of here, I've been taking care of a lost dog. Right now, it's time to feed him.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哦，对了...！
在西北方向的墓地里，我一直在照顾一只走失的狗。现在该喂它了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Sorry for the hassle,
but would you go and
feed the dog for me?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
抱歉给你添麻烦了，能麻烦你去喂一下那只狗吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFSister Asthe gives
you some dog food.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF阿斯忒修女给了你一些狗粮。^000000

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ah...
I believe
this is a test
given to you by God.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
啊...
我想这是上帝给你的考验。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You already
know the answer.
Think carefully
and it will come.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你已经知道答案了。
仔细思考，答案就会浮现。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
When you open the
Skill Window, you'll see that you can also learn ^3131FFDemon Bane^000000 and ^3131FFAngelus^000000, depending on your level of Divine Protection.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
当你打开技能窗口时，你会发现根据你天使之护的等级，还可以学习^3131FF天使之击^000000和^3131FF天使之障壁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now, ^3131FFDemon Bane^000000 increases your Attack Strength against Undead and Demon monsters, so it's useful for those of us who serve God by expelling evil.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
现在，^3131FF天使之击^000000能增加你对不死系和恶魔系魔物的攻击力，对于像我们这样侍奉上帝、驱逐邪恶的人来说非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Once you have learned Level 3 Demon Bane, you can learn ^3131FFSignum Crucis^000000 which decreases the defense of the targeted Undead or Ghost monster.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
当你学会3级天使之击后，就可以学习^3131FF天使之光^000000。该技能会降低目标不死系或幽灵系魔物的防御力。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
^3131FFAngelus^000000 increases the defense in your party, including yourself. It is affected by the VIT stat, so the higher your VIT, the better it works.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
^3131FF天使之障壁^000000可以提高队伍中所有成员（包括你自己）的防御力。该技能受VIT属性影响，VIT越高，效果越好。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
That's about it
for Divine Protection.
Let's take a break before
we proceed to the next lesson,
alright? I'll be right here.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
关于天使之护，就讲到这里。
在继续下一课之前，先休息一下，好吗？
我就在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
You can learn Increase AGI after you learn Level 3 ^3131FFHeal^000000. True to its name, Increase AGI temporarily increases the ^3131FFagility (AGI)^000000 of its target.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
当你学会3级^3131FF治愈术^000000后，就可以学习加速术。顾名思义，加速术会暂时提升目标的^3131FF敏捷 (AGI)^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Increase AGI
also increases
^3131FFDodge Rate^000000,
^3131FFAttack Speed^000000,
and ^3131FFMovement Speed^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
加速术还能提升^3131FF闪避率^000000、^3131FF攻击速度^000000和^3131FF移动速度^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Try it for
yourself, okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
你自己也试试看，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Like you'd expect, Decrease AGI slows down enemies, reducing their agility, Movement Speed, Dodge Rate and Attack Speed. Its effect is the exact reverse of Increase AGI.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
不出所料，缓速术会减慢敌人的速度，降低其敏捷、移动速度、闪避率和攻击速度。其效果与加速术完全相反。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The last skill in the Heal skill tree is ^3131FFCure^000000. You can learn Cure after learning Level 2 Heal.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
治愈术技能树中的最后一个技能是^3131FF治疗术^000000。当你学会2级治愈术后，就可以学习治疗术。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Cure can remove irregular
statuses like ^3131FFSilence^000000, ^3131FFCurse^000000,
and ^3131FFStone Curse^000000. When used on Undead monsters, Cure will
actually curse them.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
治疗术可以解除^3131FF沉默^000000、^3131FF诅咒^000000和^3131FF石化^000000等异常状态。如果对不死系魔物使用，治疗术实际上会对其施加诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
For now, don't forget that the Increase AGI, Decrease AGI and
Cure skills can only be learned
by learning the Heal skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
暂时记住这一点：加速术、缓速术和治疗术这三个技能，都必须先学会治愈术才能学习。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Once you become
an Acolyte, you can
learn the ^3131FFRuwach^000000 skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
当你成为服事后，就可以学习^3131FF光猎^000000技能了。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ruwach is used to detect ^3131FFhidden enemies^000000. Mages have a similar skill called Sight, but only it can only detect enemies. Ruwach will simultaneously detect and
damage hidden enemies.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
光猎用于探测^3131FF隐藏的敌人^000000。魔法师有一个类似的技能叫火狩，但它只能探测敌人。而光猎在探测隐藏敌人的同时，还会对其造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
After you have learned Ruwach,
you can learn ^3131FFTeleport^000000. Teleport will instantly send you to a random spot on the map or to your Save Point.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
当你学会光猎后，就可以学习^3131FF瞬间移动^000000。瞬间移动会立即将你传送到地图上的随机位置，或者你的存档点。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
After learning Level 2 Teleport, you can learn ^3131FFWarp Portal^000000 which will allow you to warp to a Memo Point, or saved destination, by consuming ^FF00001 Blue Gemstone^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
当你学会2级瞬间移动后，就可以学习^3131FF传送之阵^000000。该技能允许你消耗^FF00001个蓝色魔力矿石^000000，传送到备忘点，即你保存的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Once you have mastered Warp Portal you can ^3131FFremember three Memo Points^000000. You can't save Memo Points in most fields or dungeons, but you can use the ^FF0000/memo^000000 command in
towns and certain fields.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
当你精通传送之阵后，可以^3131FF记忆三个备忘点^000000。在大多数野外地图或地下城无法保存备忘点，但你可以使用^FF0000/memo^000000命令在城镇和某些野外地图进行保存。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Was that confusing?
Just think that Teleport
and Warp Portal allow servants
of God to move swiftly from place
to place.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
这听起来很复杂吗？
只需这样想：瞬间移动和传送之阵能让上帝的仆人在不同地点之间迅速移动。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I have my home and the convent saved as Memo Points, so I simply warp back and forth between work and home.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我把我的家和修女院保存为备忘点，所以我可以简单地来回传送，往返于工作和家之间。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now...
The last skill
of the Ruwach tree
is called ^3131FFPneuma^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那么...
光猎技能树中的最后一个技能叫做^3131FF光之障壁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Pneuma shields characters
within a 3*3 block, or a 9 cell area, from ^FF0000long range attacks^000000. If you party with Archers or other Bow users, be careful since you might accidentally block their attacks.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
光之障壁可以保护3*3格（即9格范围）内的角色免受^FF0000远程攻击^000000。如果你与弓箭手或其他使用弓的队友组队，请小心，因为可能会意外阻挡他们的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
There are some Undead monsters
that can attack from a distance, so protecting yourself with Pneuma and attacking with Heal would be a good strategy.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
有些不死系魔物可以进行远程攻击，所以用光之障壁保护自己，同时用治愈术攻击，会是一个不错的策略。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Now, we've covered some
pretty complicated material in this lesson. Would you like to hear this again?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
好，这节课我们讲了一些相当复杂的内容。
你想再听一遍吗？

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再听一遍

scripts.text: Move to the next topic.
scripts.translation: 进入下一个话题

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Alright,
give me a moment
to catch my breath~
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
好的，请给我一点时间喘口气~

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ho ho!
What a smart Acolyte~
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
呵呵！
真是个聪明的服事~

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Would you do another favor for me again? Please distribute the mail here and to Prontera Church since
I simply don't have the time.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
能再帮我一个忙吗？
请把这些信件送到这里和普隆德拉教堂，因为我实在没有时间。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
It seems that some of these are more urgent than others, so would you please deliver them in a certain order?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
看起来有些信件比其他更紧急，所以请按照特定的顺序投递好吗？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The first is a package to a worker in the north. His name is ^3131FFVeiner^000000. The next delivery is for ^3131FFHedrick^000000, who's near the convent entrance.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
第一封是寄给北方一位工人的，他的名字是^3131FF维纳^000000。
下一封是寄给^3131FF赫德里克^000000的，他在修女院入口附近。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The third one is from the Blacksmith Guild to the ^3131FFBlacksmith^000000 who makes weapons and armor for Monks. The fourth delivery goes to ^3131FFPriest Karven^000000 in the next building.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
第三封是来自铁匠公会的，要寄给为武僧打造武器和盔甲的^3131FF铁匠^000000。
第四封要寄给隔壁建筑的^3131FF牧师 卡尔文^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh, and this last delivery is a receipt for ^3131FFPriest Praupin^000000, the priest who told you about me.
Here you go, the letters and packages...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哦，还有这最后一封，是寄给^3131FF牧师 普劳频^000000的收据，就是那位向你提起我的牧师。
给你，这些信件和包裹...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh...!
You don't seem to
have enough space
to carry everything.
Why don't you put some of your things in Kafra Storage first?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哦...！
你似乎没有足够的空间携带所有东西。
为什么不先把一些东西放进卡普拉仓库呢？

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The first is a package to a worker in the north. His name is ^3131FFVeiner^000000. The next delivery is for ^3131FFHedrick^000000, who's near the convent entrance.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
第一封是寄给北方一位工人的，他的名字是^3131FF维纳^000000。
下一封是寄给^3131FF赫德里克^000000的，他在修女院入口附近。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
The third one is from the Blacksmith Guild to the ^3131FFBlacksmith^000000 who makes weapons and armor for Monks. The fourth delivery goes to ^3131FFPriest Karven^000000 in the next building.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
第三封是来自铁匠公会的，要寄给为武僧打造武器和盔甲的^3131FF铁匠^000000。
第四封要寄给隔壁建筑的^3131FF牧师 卡尔文^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh, and this last delivery is a receipt for ^3131FFPriest Praupin^000000, the priest who told you about me. Alright, have a safe trip~
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哦，还有这最后一封，是寄给^3131FF牧师 普劳频^000000的收据，就是那位向你提起我的牧师。
好了，一路顺风~

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
We make relationships with other people throughout our lives and our memories of them live on in our hearts, you know.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我们在生活中与他人建立关系，对他们的记忆会留在我们心中，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
When you feel lonely, let those memories shine through your dark gloom. Just thinking about the people you care about can heal your emotional wounds when times are rough.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
当你感到孤独时，让那些记忆照亮你的黑暗。
只要想想你在意的人，就能在艰难时刻治愈你的情感创伤。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Those who can cherish the present can form lasting relationships. They're the first who will embrace happiness in the future. Remember that.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那些能珍惜当下的人，能建立持久的关系。
他们将是未来最先拥抱幸福的人。
请记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I get the feeling that you have become a good friend to Priest Praupin. I hope that Priest Praupin continues to be a good friend to you as well.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我感觉你已经成为牧师 普劳频的好朋友了。
我希望牧师 普劳频也能继续做你的好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Alright then,
the next time we
meet, I will give
you my final lesson.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那么，下次我们见面时，我会给你上最后一课。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Water is so commonplace that
we forget that it's at the center of nature. It's very basic, but essential.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
水是如此常见，以至于我们忘记了它是自然的核心。
它很基础，但至关重要。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Place the water into a cup like so and focus all of your holy energy like this... And then...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
像这样把水放进杯子里，然后像这样集中你所有的神圣能量...
然后...

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Aqua
Benedicta!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
天使之泪！

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
This is how you create ^3131FFHoly Water^000000. Remember that your ^3131FFfeet must be touching water^000000 in order to use the Aqua Benedicta skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
这就是制作^3131FF圣水^000000的方法。请记住，为了使用天使之泪技能，你的^3131FF双脚必须接触水面^000000。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Ho ho~
Well, that's all
I have to teach you.
It may have been rough,
but you did a good job.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
呵呵~
好了，我要教你的都教完了。
虽然过程可能有些艰难，但你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Oh! If you go back to the Prontera Sanctuary, I believe you can learn a secret skill. It couldn't hurt to stop by and check.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
哦！如果你回到普隆德拉圣堂，我想你可以学会一个秘密技能。不妨去那里看看。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
Well, please don't forget what I've taught you. I hope you look back with fondness at our time together amongst these beautiful flowers. May God bless you~
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
那么，请不要忘记我教给你的东西。希望你能带着美好的回忆，回想我们在这美丽花丛中相处的时光。愿上帝保佑你~

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
With such warm delicious food in your body, all angry feelings will melt away like the snow.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
有了如此温暖美味的食物在体内，所有的愤怒都会像雪一样融化。

scripts.text:
[Asthe]
I'm not joking!
If you happen to get in a fight with someone close to you, this might help. I'm speaking from life experience, you know.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯忒]
我没开玩笑！
如果你不小心和亲近的人发生了争执，这可能会有帮助。我可是根据生活经验这么说的哦。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Hmm...?
What's that?
You have something for me?
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
嗯...？
那是什...
你有东西要给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Hmm...?
What's that?
You have something for
me? A letter you say?
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
嗯...？
那是什...
你有东西要给我吗？是一封信吗？

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Oh...!
You've returned!
Let's see... One...
Two... Three...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
哦...！
你回来了！
让我看看...一...
二...三...

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
A few days ago, a sister in Prontera
sent me a telegram that citizens had been harmed
by Hornets in the western field,
so she asked the abbey to help with them.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
几天前，普隆德拉的一位修女给我发来了电报，说西边的田野有市民被蜂兵伤害了，所以她请求修女院提供帮助。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
A little while ago, the Payon Elder sent me a message. Apparently,
the residents of Payon are being attacked by Zombies.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
刚才，斐扬的长老给我发来了消息。看来，斐扬的居民正在遭受腐尸的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
May light always
come and illuminate
the darkness. In times
of hardship, remind us
that there are no miracles
without hope...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
愿光明永远降临，照亮黑暗。在艰难的时刻，请提醒我们，没有希望就没有奇迹...

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Oh! This is a letter from my mother back home. Thank you for bringing this to me, young Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
哦！这是我老家母亲寄来的信。谢谢你把它带给我，年轻的服事。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
I've worried about
her, especially since
she is getting old now, but I'm relieved to hear that her health
is good. We are truly blessed...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
我一直很担心她，尤其是她现在年纪大了，但听到她身体很好，我松了一口气。我们真是有福了...

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Well, it seems that
you must have forgotten
it or misplaced it somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
看来，你一定是把它忘了，或者把它弄丢在什么地方了。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Thank you very much!
You've done a great job
on behalf of the convent,
not to mention the fact that
you've protected the citizens
of {0} from danger.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
非常感谢！
你为修女院做了很大的贡献，更不用说你还保护了{0}的市民免受危险。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
May you always
be blessed. Now, you
should return to Sister
Asthe to continue your
Acolyte training.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
愿你永远蒙受祝福。现在，你应该回到修女阿斯忒那里，继续你的服事训练。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
But at this time,
we are also short of hands...
so it's a big problem.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
但在这个时候，我们也人手不足...
所以这是个很大的问题。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
....!
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
....！

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
May I entrust you, acolyte {0},
this urgent matter?
Please dispose of Hornets
which are causing trouble on ^FF0000the western field of Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
服事{0}，我可以把这件紧急的事情托付给你吗？
请去处理那些在^FF0000普隆德拉西边的田野^000000造成麻烦的蜂兵。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
I know that you are undergoing the discipline,
So I will give you something to help you
if you bring me ^3131FF 5^000000 ^3131FFBee Sting^000000.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
我知道你正在接受修炼，所以如果你能带给我^3131FF5个^000000^3131FF蜂针^000000，我会给你一些帮助。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Will you go to Prontera?
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
你要去普隆德拉吗？

scripts.text: Let's go to Prontera!
scripts.translation: 去普隆德拉！

scripts.text: I'll be back after doing some preparation.
scripts.translation: 我先做些准备再回来

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Okay, I will send you to Prontera.
Please dispose of Hornets and bring me 5 Bee Stings for confirmation.
My Lord, please protect this acolyte from evil monsters.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
好的，我会送你去普隆德拉。
请消灭蜂兵，并带给我5个蜂针以作确认。
主啊，请保护这位服事免受邪恶魔物的侵害。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
He has requested the convent for help, but we've got a big problem. We're running out of people here that can deal with this situation...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
他向修女院请求了帮助，但我们遇到了大麻烦。这里能处理这种情况的人手快不够了...

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
....!
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
....！

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
{0},
may I ask
you to take care
of this task? Exterminate the Skeletons and Zombies in the
First Floor of Payon Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
{0}，我可以拜托你处理这件事吗？请消灭斐扬地下城第一层的邪骸战士和腐尸。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Since you're still in basic training, I will give you some
help if you return with
^3131FF5 Decayed Nails^000000.
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
既然你还在基础训练中，如果你能带回来^3131FF5个亡者指甲^000000，我会给你一些帮助。

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Now then...
Will you go to Payon?
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
那么...
你要去斐扬吗？

scripts.text: Let's go to Payon!
scripts.translation: 去斐扬！

scripts.text: Um, let me get ready first.
scripts.translation: 嗯，让我先准备一下

scripts.text:
[Priest Gardron]
Good, good.
I shall send you
there to fight the monsters in Payon Dungeon so that you can return with 5 Decayed Nails. May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[牧师 加德伦]
很好，很好。
我会送你去那里，去斐扬地下城战斗，以便你能带回来5个亡者指甲。愿上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Dog]
^CDB79EBark bark!
Woof woof!^000000
Give a treat.
scripts.translation: 喂零食

scripts.text: Pet the dog.
scripts.translation: 抚摸狗

scripts.text: End actions.
scripts.translation: 结束互动

scripts.text:
[Dog]
^CDB79EGrrrrrr...!^000000

^3355FFThe dog grinds
its teeth and glares
at you menacingly.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF狗磨着牙，凶狠地盯着你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dog]
^CDB79ERoof roof!^000000

[Dog]
^CDB79ERoof roof~^000000

[Dog]
^CDB79ERoof roof!^000000

[{0}]
So cute~!

[Angelic]
Thanks for helping me.
I'm sad my older sister is no longer with me, but I oughta
cheer up, right? I'll try my best!
scripts.translation:
[安洁莉可]
谢谢你帮助我。
虽然姐姐已经不在了，让我很难过，但我应该振作起来，对吧？我会加油的！

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
Sister, don't go...
^333333*Sniff* *Cough cough!*^000000
It h-hurts so... much...!
Sis...ter...

[Angelic]
^333333*Sniff...*^000000
Are you from
the convent?
scripts.translation:
[安洁莉可]
^333333*吸鼻子...*^000000
你是从修女院来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
Save...
My sister...
scripts.translation:
[安洁莉可]
救救...
我姐姐...

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
^333333*Sniff sniff*
^333333*Cough cough*
H-hurts...
Are you alright?
scripts.translation: 你还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
My sister...
She was so beautiful...
She was such a nice girl.
But then, one day...
scripts.translation:
[安洁莉可]
我姐姐...
她那么美丽...
她是个那么善良的女孩。
可是有一天...

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
This disgusting looking
person was coated in this icky stuff and attacked her. She was poisoned and her body became
colder and... ^333333*Sniff*^000000
scripts.translation:
[安洁莉可]
那个长相丑陋的人浑身涂满了恶心的东西，袭击了她。她被毒害了，身体变得冰冷... ^333333*吸鼻子*^000000

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
I was with her and I got sick too. I wasn't poisoned as badly, but
my whole body feels heavy and I've been having these nightmares...
scripts.translation:
[安洁莉可]
我当时就在她身边，所以我也生病了。虽然我没有中毒那么严重，但全身都很沉重，而且一直做噩梦...

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
^333333*Cough cough!*^000000
Will I join my
sister like this?
scripts.translation:
[安洁莉可]
^333333*咳咳！*^000000
我会像姐姐一样离大家而去吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis girl looks
really sick. Maybe you
should take a better look
and see what's wrong.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这个女孩看起来病得很重。也许你应该仔细检查一下，看看她怎么了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is....!
A cursed spirit
is tormenting this
poor young girl!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是....！
一个被诅咒的恶灵正在折磨这个可怜的年轻女孩！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll cure you...
For sure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会治好你的...
一定可以。

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
It hurts...!
I... I can't...!
scripts.translation:
[安洁莉可]
好痛...！
我...我做不到...！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou go towards
the girl, place your hands
on her back and perform
a holy spell...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你走向那个女孩，把手放在她的背上，施展神圣法术...^000000

scripts.text: Heal!
scripts.translation: 治愈术！

scripts.text: Blessing!
scripts.translation: 天使之赐福！

scripts.text: Cure!
scripts.translation: 治疗术！

scripts.text: Recovery!
scripts.translation: 恢复！

scripts.text: Signum Crucis!
scripts.translation: 天使之光！

scripts.text: B.S Sacramenti!
scripts.translation: 圣之祈福！

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
It doesn't look like
that skill will work.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什么也没发生。
看来这个技能无法使用。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
B...
Blessing!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天...天使之赐福！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I...
I did it!!

^3355FFWhat a great
chance for you to
practice your abilities!
It seemed that this good
deed has improved your skills.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF真是个好机会，让你练习一下自己的能力！
看来这个善举提升了你的技能。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
It's not working...
Maybe it's because
I'm still learning?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦...？
没有效果...
也许是因为我还在学？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou didn't learn
this skill yet, so you're
not able to use it for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你还没有学会这个技能，所以现在无法使用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
It doesn't look like
that skill will work.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什么也没发生。
看来这个技能无法使用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou didn't learn
this skill yet, so you're
not able to use it for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你还没有学会这个技能，所以现在无法使用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis isn't a skill
that Acolytes can use...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这不是服事能用的技能...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
S-Signum...
Signum Crucis!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天...天使之光！
天使之光！

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
It doesn't look like
that skill will work.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什么也没发生。
看来这个技能无法使用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou didn't learn
this skill yet, so you're
not able to use it for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你还没有学会这个技能，所以现在无法使用。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis isn't a skill
that Acolytes can use...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这不是服事能用的技能...^000000

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
Ah...
I feel...
So relaxed.
So much lighter...
scripts.translation:
[安洁莉可]
啊...
我感觉...
好轻松。
轻松多了...

scripts.text:
[Angelic]
Did you
do this?
Is this the
power of God?
scripts.translation:
[安洁莉可]
是你做的吗？
这就是神的力量吗？

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
So very exhausted...
Should I just go back home?
scripts.translation:
[维纳]
好累啊...
我还是回家吧？

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
I can't wait
to see her again!
Bibi...! I loooove you!
scripts.translation:
[维纳]
我迫不及待想再见到她！
比比...！我超...超爱你！

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
So very
exhausted...
Would you help
me carry my stuff?
P-please...
scripts.translation:
[维纳]
好累啊...
你能帮我拿一下东西吗？
求...求你了...

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
What's that?
You have a delivery
for me? Why, what
ever could it be?
scripts.translation:
[维纳]
什么？
你有东西要寄给我？
哎呀，会是什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
This is...!
It's Handmade Chocolate
from my honey bunny!
Oh Bibi! You're the best!
scripts.translation:
[维纳]
这是...！
是我亲爱的比比送的手工巧克力！
哦比比！你最棒了！

scripts.text:
[Veiner]
Oh right!
Thank you very much for delivering this to me. Sorry, but I'm always excited to hear from my cutie pie~
scripts.translation:
[维纳]
对了！
非常感谢你把它送到我这里。抱歉，我一收到我宝贝的消息就总是这么兴奋~

scripts.text:
[Hedrick]
^333333*Whew!*^000000
Man I worked hard today!
And so efficiently too!
Awesome job as usual,
Hedrick. You're number one!
scripts.translation:
[赫德里克]
^333333*呼！*^000000
我今天工作好辛苦啊！
而且效率也很高！
一如既往的出色，赫德里克。你是第一！

scripts.text:
[Hedrick]
Oh...?
Is this letter for me?
I wonder who it's from.
Ah, it's from my mom!
scripts.translation:
[赫德里克]
哦...？
这封信是给我的吗？
不知道是谁寄来的。
啊，是我妈妈寄来的！

scripts.text:
[Hedrick]
Whoa...!
Holy cow!
This letter is
full of the energy
of motherly love!
scripts.translation:
[赫德里克]
哇...！
天哪！
这封信充满了母爱的力量！

scripts.text:
[Hedrick]
Thanks a lot!
Here, why don't
you have one of the
cookies she sent me?
scripts.translation:
[赫德里克]
非常感谢！
来，尝尝她寄给我的饼干吧？

scripts.text:
[Weapon Merchant]
The stuff I requested from the guild is finally here!
It's pretty tough to keep everything in stock since this is such a remote place.
scripts.translation:
[武器商人]
我从公会订购的东西终于到了！
因为这里地处偏远，保持库存充足相当困难。

scripts.text:
[Weapon Merchant]
Hey, thanks so much!
Oh, and come here if
you need anything, okay?
scripts.translation:
[武器商人]
嘿，非常感谢！
哦，如果你需要什么，随时过来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Karven]
May you rest
in peace forever...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔文]
愿您永远安息...

scripts.text:
[Karven]
May you rest
rest in peace...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔文]
愿您安息...

scripts.text:
[Karven]
I'm saying prayers
for the recently departed.
If it's not urgent, please
come again at another time.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔文]
我正在为新近逝者祈祷。
如果不急的话，请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Karven]
A letter?
Oh. It must be from
my younger sister.
What could she want
this time?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔文]
一封信？
哦。一定是我妹妹寄来的。
她这次又想要什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Karven]
I hope she realizes
the word of God and returns
to living a good life once
again. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔文]
我希望她能领悟神的旨意，重新过上美好的生活。非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
Hi, hi~
I'm Gloria.
You wanna know
something neat
about my name?
scripts.translation:
[格洛丽亚]
嗨，嗨~
我是格洛丽亚。
你想不想知道关于我名字的一个有趣的事情？

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
I'm still
a young Acolyte
in training and I'm
always making mistakes!
scripts.translation:
[格洛丽亚]
我仍然是一名正在训练中的服事，我总是犯错误！

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
Wow...
Did you learn all that from Asthe? That's so great...
You must be so much better than me that I can't even brag about warping to
Prontera anymore. ^333333*Sniff*^000000
scripts.translation:
[格洛丽亚]
哇...
这些你都从阿斯忒那里学来了吗？太厉害了...
你一定比我强多了，我甚至都不能再吹嘘我能传送到普隆德拉了。^333333*吸鼻子*^000000

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
My father was a Blacksmith in Geffen, and supposedly he finished an incredible weapon on the day
I was born. He thought it was a sign of good luck, so he named
the weapon after me!
scripts.translation:
[格洛丽亚]
我的父亲是吉芬的铁匠，据说在我出生的那天，他完成了一件不可思议的武器。他认为这是好运的象征，所以用我的名字给那件武器命名了！

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
It's a little strange knowing that there's a weapon named after
you, but I like my name very much. I mean, it's not like my parents named me after that weapon, right?
scripts.translation:
[格洛丽亚]
知道有一件武器是用你的名字命名的，感觉有点奇怪，但我非常喜欢我的名字。毕竟，也不是我父母用那件武器给我命名的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
^333333*Sniff*^000000
And I get scolded
almost all the time...
But there's one thing
that I can do really well!
scripts.translation:
[格洛丽亚]
^333333*吸鼻子*^000000
而且我几乎总是被责骂...
但有一件事我做得非常好！

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
Warp portal!
I know Level 2 Warp Portal!
One of my Memo Points is here
and the other is in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[格洛丽亚]
传送之阵！
我会2级传送之阵！
我的一个备忘点在这里，另一个在普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Gloria]
Anyway, whenever
you need to, I can
send you to Prontera.
Just let me know, okay?
scripts.translation:
[格洛丽亚]
总之，如果你需要的话，我可以把你传送到普隆德拉。

scripts.text:

^A68064Sir...

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600What's wrong?
Did something happen?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^CD6600怎么了？
发生什么事了吗？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064I'm not sure.
I can't explain exactly what it is, but the officials seem frightened about something. Maybe there
was some sort of accident?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^A68064我也不清楚。
我说不清具体是什么，但官员们似乎很害怕。
也许发生了什么事故？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Hmm, I wouldn't know.
Why don't we just wait and see
what happens? I'm sure the truth will come out one way or another.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^CD6600嗯，我哪知道。
不如就等着看吧，真相总会水落石出的。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064 Alright, sir.
Still, I can't help
but feel uneasy...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^A68064好的，大人。

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064I heard from an
official at the palace
that they're requesting
us for an exorcism.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^A68064我听说皇宫的官员正在请求我们进行驱魔仪式。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Exorcism?
Did Zombies attack
the kingdom or something?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^CD6600驱魔？

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064No, I don't think
that's the case, but
they are requesting
a highly skilled holy person...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^A68064不，我觉得不是那样，但他们要求一位技艺高超的神圣人士...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Hmm...
I wonder what
exactly is going on...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^CD6600嗯...
真不知道到底发生了什么...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064I will inform you
as soon as I hear
something.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^A68064一有消息，我会立刻通知您。^000000

scripts.text:

^CD6600Thank you...^000000

[Voices from Window]
^A68064...Sir, do you know anything about the ^855E42curse of the Gaebolg family^A68064?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^A68064...大人，您听说过^855E42吉尔伯格家族的诅咒^A68064吗？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600The Gaebolg?
Are you telling me
there's a curse on
the royal family?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^CD6600吉尔伯格？
你是说王室有诅咒？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064Yes...

highness, King Tristam III,
and his courtiers have been
acting strangely lately...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^A68064是的...
也许这就是为什么国王特里斯坦三世和他的朝臣们最近行为怪异...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064You see...
Yormungard is
said to have cursed
the Gaebolg family when Rune-Midgarts was first established.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^A68064您看...
据说在卢恩·米德加兹建国之初，耶梦加得就诅咒了吉尔伯格家族。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Yormungard?!
How can we hope
to combat its magic?
Not even the Asgardians
could deal with that
giant serpent's power!^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^CD6600耶梦加得？！
我们怎么可能对抗它的魔法？
连阿斯加德人都无法应对那条巨蛇的力量！^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064It's horrible...

the first child of every generation of the Gaebolg family will supposedly die an early death...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^A68064太可怕了...
因为诅咒，吉尔伯格家族每一代的长子都会英年早逝...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Are you saying that all of the first princes and princesses
have died to this day? If this is true, it'd cause trouble if word got out...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^CD6600你是说，直到今天为止，所有的长子长女都死去了吗？如果这是真的，消息一旦传出去，就会引起大麻烦...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Is that what happened
in the palace? Did the eldest prince pass away recently?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^CD6600难道就是发生在宫殿里的事吗？大王子最近去世了吗？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064 No...

eldest prince passed
away, not the first.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^A68064不...
实际上，是二王子去世了，不是大王子。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600What!?^000000

[Voices from Window]
^A68064L-lower your voice!^000000

[Voices from Window]
^CD6600So...
How did it happen?
Was it an accident?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^CD6600那么...
这是怎么发生的？
是意外吗？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^A68064 They haven't determined
the exact reason of the death yet. But the court officials want us to see if we can undo Yormungard's curse once and for all.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^A68064目前还没有确定确切死因。但朝廷官员希望我们能看看，是否有可能彻底解除耶梦加得的诅咒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voices from Window]
^CD6600Yormungard's curse?
Is it possible to remove it after so many years? Such ancient
magic may be too powerful for
any of us in the Church...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗外的声音]
^CD6600耶梦加得的诅咒？
过了这么多年，还能解除吗？如此古老的魔法可能太强大了，我们教会里没人能办到...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^A68064This task is monumentally huge!
And if we should fail, we'd lose the faith of our constituents. The Church and the Royal Court truly need a miracle...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗边的声音]
^A68064这项任务艰巨无比！
如果我们失败了，就会失去信众的信任。教会和王室真的需要一个奇迹...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^CD6600Well, what's the Church's response? Are we really going to send someone to lift the curse of a monster that can challenge the Asgardians?^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗边的声音]
^CD6600那么，教会的回应是什么？我们真的要派人去解除那个能挑战阿斯加德人的魔物的诅咒吗？^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^A68064I'm not quite sure.
Those that might have
the necessary skill are
too old. Still, they're
not giving up hope...^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗边的声音]
^A68064我不太确定。
那些可能具备必要能力的人都太老了。不过，他们并没有放弃希望...^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^A68064This situation is very important to the reputation of the royal family and stability of the kingdom, so everyone's been very careful
about keeping quiet.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗边的声音]
^A68064这种情况对王室的声誉和王国的稳定非常重要，所以大家都很小心地保守秘密。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^A68064For now, I'll return to the kingdom and let you know if I hear of any other news. Still, since everyone needs to be so careful, it may be
a while until I learn anything new.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗边的声音]
^A68064目前，我会先回王国，如果听到其他消息会通知你。不过，既然大家都需要如此小心，可能要过一段时间我才能得知新消息。^000000

scripts.text:
[Voice from Window]
^CD6600Thank you very much.
I'll be waiting to hear
from you again.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗边的声音]
^CD6600非常感谢。
我会等待你的消息。^000000

^CD6600Oh dear God.
Please expel the darkness that approaches the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Please protect us with your light and compassion.^000000
scripts.translation:
[窗边的声音]
^CD6600哦，我的上帝。
请驱散逼近卢恩·米德加兹王国的黑暗。请用你的光和慈悲保护我们。^000000
